item.title: SmartCut 1.1.0
item.description: • Tap ⌘ twice for a command bar: besides the app's commands it opens apps, switches to windows and browser tabs, finds files (and hands bigger searches to Rummage), runs your Shortcuts and System Settings pages, and works out sums, unit conversions, physics constants, time zones and currency. ⌘V and ⌘C now work in the search field.
